bottleneck: A candidate momentum effect may depend on market regime even after horizon robustness.
deliverable: A falsifiable regime-conditioned momentum result with independent verification.
evidence_basis: MA regime filters were previously falsified; whether the same class of conditioning helps the different momentum mechanism remains unresolved.
objective: Test one explicitly predeclared past-only volatility gate on lookback-5 momentum through the existing regime-stability and null framework.

preceding_agent.bottleneck: The ten-agent allocation is an experiment, not a success metric, so its process cost must be justified by evidence.
preceding_agent.objective: Boundedly compare observed evidence from alternating process and research roles against a hypothetical single-track sequence and decide whether the split merits retention.
preceding_agent.observed_effect: Evidence from four completed agents shows the alternating pattern produces complementary learning: Agent 1 (LEARNING_PROCESS) identified process efficiency improvements through focused-task selector auditing; Agent 3 (LEARNING_PROCESS) documented duplicate-work prevention effectiveness; Agents 2 & 4 (HIGHER_ORDER_OBJECTIVE) conducted specialized research (cost robustness, holding-period sensitivity). The pattern alternates between systematic process audits and targeted research, generating evidence that supports both process improvements and research progress.
preceding_agent.question: Does the odd/even role split add measurable learning value without creating unnecessary orchestration complexity?
preceding_agent.uncertainty_reduced: Learning efficiency gains from alternating process-research roles documented.
preceding_agent.uncertainty_targeted: Role split value vs single-track sequence.

primary_question: Does a single past-only volatility gate create a predeclared robustness improvement for the qualified momentum effect?
scope: One volatility feature, one threshold rule declared before execution, existing 10-asset universe.

selection_basis.reason: highest evidence-backed qualitative priority among currently OPEN tasks for this role

stop_condition: Stop after the one predeclared gate is evaluated and independently checked.
success_criterion: The gate either demonstrates a reproducible improvement in robustness or is falsified/unsupported.
verification_requirement: Leakage gate, matched null, regime-stability, independent recomputation, determinism.
